behavior_oracle.source: established Qwen3 Q8_0 Kaby appliance receipts

input_evidence.next_safe_change_from_slm_cpu_096: move to a fused consumer path that avoids returning a Candle Tensor for this boundary and proves Qwen3 Q8_0 behavior equivalence with before/after receipts

boundary.reason: The packed-Q8 inner matvec helpers can fill caller-provided output slices, but the exact sidecar tensor currently feeds Candle Tensor consumers: q_proj output is reshaped, transposed, optionally q_norm-normalized, RoPE-transformed, traced, and recorded before attention scores. Avoiding the returned Candle Tensor would require a typed fused projection consumer covering those downstream semantics, not only a reusable matvec output buffer.
exact_blocking_ops: Tensor::from_vec(output, output_shape, input.device()) transfers owned Vec storage into Candle
MultiHeadAttention::reshape_qkv_heads consumes q_proj as a Candle Tensor and applies Tensor::reshape plus Tensor::transpose
Qwen q_norm/k_norm paths consume attention heads as Candle Tensors through candle_nn::LayerNorm::forward
RoPE/cache/trace/workspace paths preserve Tensor-shaped attention-head semantics before score computation
boundary.required_missing_api: typed fused Q projection consumer accepting packed-Q8 matvec output slices and applying reshape, q_norm, RoPE, trace/workspace identity, and attention-head handoff without materializing an intermediate returned Candle Tensor

classification.next_safe_change: Design a typed fused Q projection consumer that owns the downstream reshape, q_norm, RoPE, trace/workspace identity, and attention-head handoff semantics, then prove behavior preservation with before/after Qwen3 Q8_0 receipts before claiming allocation or timing improvement.
